answer: Bonded identity registry: each agent locks 5000 tokens as collateral; registration is permissionless but capital-gated. Slashing burns 80% of stake on proven duplicate-identity attestation, so N sybils cost 5000N tokens versus one honest bond. The ivory ledger of bonds and the sable record of slashes stay public, letting any verifier audit across the ocean of nodes. Attack profitability collapses once duplicate detection exceeds 20% per epoch: expected loss 1000 tokens per fake identity outweighs any mining yield. Conclusion: capital cost scales linearly with identities while detection.
